home.homeTitle: How well do you know your friend?
home.homeDesc: One answer the questions honestly, the other try to guess what the other one picked. The score tells the truth.
home.noAccountCardDesc: Nothing to sign up for, nothing stored anywhere.
home.justLinkCardDesc: Create a game and send the link to your friend.
home.peerCardDesc: Your two browsers talk directly to each other.
home.footerText: This game runs entirely in your browsers over a direct peer-to-peer connection. No server keeps your answers.

create.createInitialDesc: We'll set up a private room in your browser and give you a link to send to your friend.
create.createInitialFooter: Keep this tab open while your friend joins.
